get_coinm_adl_quantile.description: Query position ADL quantile estimation, returning the ADL quantile per position side for each symbol.

response_fields.name: [].adlQuantile.LONG
response_fields.description: adl quantile for "LONG" position in hedge mode

response_fields.name: [].adlQuantile.SHORT
response_fields.description: adl qauntile for "SHORT" position in hedge mode

notes: Values update every 30s.
Values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 shows the queue position and possibility of ADL from low to high.
For positions of the symbol in One-way Mode or isolated margined in Hedge Mode, "LONG", "SHORT", and "BOTH" will be returned.

If the positions of the symbol are crossed margined in Hedge Mode, "HEDGE" will be returned instead of "BOTH"; a same value calculated on unrealized pnls on long and short sides' positions will be shown for "LONG" and "SHORT" when there are positions in both sides.

get_usdm_order_rate_limit.description: Query the user's USDⓈ-M Futures order rate limits (type, interval, limit).

list_usdm_all_algo_orders.description: Get all algo (conditional) orders on USD-M Futures for a symbol, active, CANCELED, TRIGGERED or FINISHED, including TP/SL and trailing stop orders, returned as a list.

params.name: algo_id
params.description: Algo order id; returns orders >= this id.

notes: If `algoId` is set, it will get orders >= that `algoId`. Otherwise most recent orders are returned.
The query time period must be less then 7 days( default as the recent 7 days).
Orders not found: status CANCELED or EXPIRED AND no filled trade AND created time + 3 days < current time; or order create time + 90 days < current time.

list_usdm_all_orders.description: Get all account orders on USD-M Futures, active, canceled or filled, returned as a list of orders.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Order id; returns orders >= this id.

response_fields.name: [].stopPrice
response_fields.description: please ignore when order type is TRAILING_STOP_MARKET

response_fields.name: [].activatePrice
response_fields.description: activation price, only return with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

response_fields.name: [].priceRate
response_fields.description: callback rate, only return with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

response_fields.name: [].priceProtect
response_fields.description: if conditional order trigger is protected

response_fields.name: [].goodTillDate
response_fields.description: order pre-set auot cancel time for TIF GTD order

notes: If `orderId` is set, it will get orders >= that `orderId`. Otherwise most recent orders are returned.
The query time period must be less then 7 days( default as the recent 7 days).
Orders not found: status CANCELED or EXPIRED AND no filled trade AND created time + 3 days < current time; or order create time + 90 days < current time.

list_usdm_balances.description: Query USD-M Futures account balance information per asset.

response_fields.name: [].marginAvailable
response_fields.description: Whether the asset can be used as margin in multi-assets mode.

list_usdm_force_orders.description: Query the user's liquidation and auto-deleverage (ADL) force orders on USD-M Futures, returned as a list of orders.

params.name: auto_close_type
params.description: "LIQUIDATION" for liquidation orders, "ADL" for ADL orders.

notes: If "autoCloseType" is not sent, orders with both of the types will be returned
If "startTime" is not sent, data within 7 days before "endTime" can be queried

list_usdm_income_history.description: Query USD-M Futures income history (transfers, realized PnL, funding fees, commissions and similar) as a list of income records.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

notes: If `incomeType ` is not sent, all kinds of flow will be returned
If `startTime` and `endTime` are not sent, the recent 7-day data will be returned.
`trandId` is unique in the same `incomeType` for a user.
Income history only contains data for the last three months.

list_usdm_leverage_brackets.description: Query the user's notional and leverage brackets for a symbol (or all symbols) on USD-M Futures.

response_fields.name: [].notionalCoef
response_fields.description: user symbol bracket multiplier, only appears when user's symbol bracket is adjusted

response_fields.name: [].brackets[].initialLeverage
response_fields.description: Max initial leverage for this bracket

list_usdm_leverage_brackets.response_notes: Documented as oneOf: an array of per-symbol objects, or a single per-symbol object (same fields without the [] prefix) when a symbol is sent.

list_usdm_open_algo_orders.description: Get all open algo (conditional) orders on USD-M Futures, including TP/SL and trailing stop orders, returned as a list.
list_usdm_open_algo_orders.weight: 1 for a single symbol; 40 when the symbol parameter is omitted
notes: Careful when accessing this with no symbol.
If the symbol is not sent, orders for all symbols will be returned in an array.

list_usdm_open_orders.description: Get all open orders on USD-M Futures, optionally for one symbol, returned as a list of orders.
list_usdm_open_orders.weight: 1 for a single symbol; 40 when the symbol parameter is omitted

response_fields.name: [].stopPrice
response_fields.description: please ignore when order type is TRAILING_STOP_MARKET

response_fields.name: [].activatePrice
response_fields.description: activation price, only return with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

response_fields.name: [].priceRate
response_fields.description: callback rate, only return with TRAILING_STOP_MARKET order

response_fields.name: [].priceProtect
response_fields.description: if conditional order trigger is protected

response_fields.name: [].goodTillDate
response_fields.description: order pre-set auot cancel time for TIF GTD order

notes: Careful when accessing this with no symbol.
If the symbol is not sent, orders for all symbols will be returned in an array.

list_usdm_order_amendments.description: Get the modification history of a USD-M Futures order as a list of amendments with before/after price and quantity.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Timestamp in ms to get modification history from INCLUSIVE

params.name: end_time
params.description: Timestamp in ms to get modification history until INCLUSIVE

response_fields.name: [].amendment.count
response_fields.description: Order modification count, representing the number of times the order has been modified

response_fields.name: [].amendment.modifyId
response_fields.description: user-defined modification identifier, only returned if provided in the request

notes: Either `orderId` or `origClientOrderId` must be sent, and the `orderId` will prevail if both are sent.
Order modify history longer than 3 month is not avaliable

list_usdm_positions.description: Get current USD-M Futures position information (only symbols with a position or open orders are returned) as a list.

response_fields.name: [].positionAmt
response_fields.description: position amount, positive for long, negative for short

response_fields.name: [].initialMargin
response_fields.description: initial margin required with current mark price

response_fields.name: [].positionInitialMargin
response_fields.description: initial margin required for positions with current mark price

response_fields.name: [].openOrderInitialMargin
response_fields.description: initial margin required for open orders with current mark price

notes: Please use with user data stream `ACCOUNT_UPDATE` to meet your timeliness and accuracy needs.

list_usdm_symbol_config.description: Get the current account symbol configuration on USD-M Futures (margin type, auto add margin, leverage, max notional) as a list.

list_usdm_user_trades.description: Get account trades for a specific symbol on USD-M Futures, returned as a list of trades.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Must be used together with parameter `symbol`.

params.name: from_id
params.description: Trade id to fetch from. Default gets most recent trades.

response_fields.name: [].quoteQty
response_fields.description: Quote asset quantity. Populated for USDⓈ-M symbols; returns "0" for COIN-M symbols.

response_fields.name: [].baseQty
response_fields.description: Base asset quantity. Populated for COIN-M symbols; returns "0" for USDⓈ-M symbols.

notes: If `startTime` and `endTime` are both not sent, then the last 7 days' data will be returned.
The time between `startTime` and `endTime` cannot be longer than 7 days.
The parameter `fromId` cannot be sent with `startTime` or `endTime`.
Only support querying trade in the past 3 months

get_usdm_24hr_ticker.description: Returns 24-hour rolling window price change statistics for a symbol or all symbols.
get_usdm_24hr_ticker.weight: 1 for a single symbol; 40 when symbol is omitted
get_usdm_24hr_ticker.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.
notes: If the symbol is not sent, tickers for all symbols will be returned in an array.
Careful when accessing this with no symbol.

get_usdm_asset_index.description: Returns the asset index price for Multi-Assets mode.
get_usdm_asset_index.weight: 1 for a single symbol; 10 when symbol is omitted
get_usdm_asset_index.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.
notes: Effective 2026-06-30 (CM-UM Integration) the response additionally includes COIN-M settlement-asset price index entries (e.g. BTCUSD, ETHUSD, BNBUSD).

get_usdm_book_ticker.description: Returns the best bid and ask price and quantity for a symbol or all symbols.
get_usdm_book_ticker.weight: 2 for a single symbol; 5 when symbol is omitted
get_usdm_book_ticker.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.
notes: If the symbol is not sent, bookTickers for all symbols will be returned in an array.
The X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M response header is not accurate from this endpoint; ignore it.
Retail Price Improvement (RPI) orders are not visible and are excluded from the response.
Only for composite index symbols.
Returns an array of indexes when symbol is omitted and a single object when symbol is given.

get_usdm_exchange_info.description: Returns current exchange trading rules and symbol information.

response_fields.name: serverTime
response_fields.description: Ignore. To check current server time use "GET /fapi/v1/time"

response_fields.name: assets[].marginAvailable
response_fields.description: whether the asset can be used as margin in Multi-Assets mode

response_fields.name: assets[].autoAssetExchange
response_fields.description: auto-exchange threshold in Multi-Assets margin mode

response_fields.name: symbols[].pricePrecision
response_fields.description: please do not use it as tickSize

response_fields.name: symbols[].quantityPrecision
response_fields.description: please do not use it as stepSize

response_fields.name: symbols[].marketTakeBound
response_fields.description: the max price difference rate (from mark price) a market order can make

get_usdm_funding_rate_info.description: Returns funding rate info for symbols with funding rate cap, floor or interval adjustments.
notes: Shares the 500/5min/IP rate limit with GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate.
Only symbols that had FundingRateCap/FundingRateFloor/fundingIntervalHours adjustments are returned.

get_usdm_index_constituents.description: Returns the constituents of an index price.
notes: Prices from constituents of TradFi perps are hidden and displayed as -1.

get_usdm_insurance_fund_balance.description: Returns the insurance fund balance snapshot.
get_usdm_insurance_fund_balance.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.

get_usdm_long_short_ratio.description: Returns the long/short account ratio of all traders for a symbol.

response_fields.name: [].longShortRatio
response_fields.description: long/short account num ratio of all traders

response_fields.name: [].longAccount
response_fields.description: long account num ratio of all traders

response_fields.name: [].shortAccount
response_fields.description: short account num ratio of all traders

response_fields.name: [].timestamp
response_fields.description: End time of the period, in milliseconds

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
Only the data of the latest 30 days is available.
IP rate limit 1000 requests/5min

get_usdm_mark_price.description: Returns the mark price and funding rate.

response_fields.name: estimatedSettlePrice
response_fields.description: Estimated Settle Price, only useful in the last hour before the settlement starts

response_fields.name: lastFundingRate
response_fields.description: This is the Latest funding rate

get_usdm_mark_price.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.

get_usdm_open_interest.description: Returns the present open interest of a symbol.

get_usdm_order_book.description: Returns the order book for a symbol, excluding RPI orders.

response_fields.name: bids
response_fields.description: Bid orders. Each entry is [price, quantity].

response_fields.name: asks
response_fields.description: Ask orders. Each entry is [price, quantity].

get_usdm_order_book.response_notes: bids and asks entries are positional [price, quantity] string pairs.
notes: Retail Price Improvement (RPI) orders are not visible and are excluded from the response.

get_usdm_price_ticker.description: Returns the latest price for a symbol or all symbols.
get_usdm_price_ticker.weight: 1 for a single symbol; 2 when symbol is omitted
get_usdm_price_ticker.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.
notes: If the symbol is not sent, prices for all symbols will be returned in an array.
The X-MBX-USED-WEIGHT-1M response header is not accurate from this endpoint; ignore it.

get_usdm_rpi_order_book.description: Returns the order book for a symbol including RPI orders.

response_fields.name: bids
response_fields.description: Bid orders. Each entry is [price, quantity].

response_fields.name: asks
response_fields.description: Ask orders. Each entry is [price, quantity].

get_usdm_rpi_order_book.response_notes: bids and asks entries are positional [price, quantity] string pairs.
notes: RPI (Retail Price Improvement) orders are included and aggregated in the response.
Crossed price levels are hidden and invisible.

get_usdm_server_time.description: Tests connectivity and returns the current server time.

get_usdm_symbol_adl_risk.description: Returns the symbol-level ADL risk rating (high, medium or low), updated every 30 minutes.
get_usdm_symbol_adl_risk.response_notes: Without symbol the response is an array of these objects; with symbol it is a single object.
notes: The rating can be high, medium or low and is updated every 30 minutes.

get_usdm_top_trader_account_ratio.description: Returns the net long/short account proportion of the top 20% of users by margin balance.

response_fields.name: [].longShortRatio
response_fields.description: long/short account num ratio of top traders

response_fields.name: [].longAccount
response_fields.description: long account num ratio of top traders

response_fields.name: [].shortAccount
response_fields.description: short account num ratio of top traders

response_fields.name: [].timestamp
response_fields.description: End time of the period, in milliseconds

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
Only the data of the latest 30 days is available.
IP rate limit 1000 requests/5min

get_usdm_top_trader_position_ratio.description: Returns the net long/short position proportion of the top 20% of users by margin balance.

response_fields.name: [].longShortRatio
response_fields.description: long/short position ratio of top traders

response_fields.name: [].longAccount
response_fields.description: long positions ratio of top traders

response_fields.name: [].shortAccount
response_fields.description: short positions ratio of top traders

response_fields.name: [].timestamp
response_fields.description: End time of the period, in milliseconds

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
Only the data of the latest 30 days is available.
IP rate limit 1000 requests/5min

get_usdm_trading_schedule.description: Returns trading session schedules for the underlying assets of TradFi perpetuals.
notes: Schedules cover a one-week period forward and one-week backward from the day prior to the query time.
Session types: U.S. equity: PRE_MARKET, REGULAR, AFTER_MARKET, OVERNIGHT, NO_TRADING; commodity, Korean, Hong Kong and China equity, and FX markets: REGULAR, NO_TRADING.

list_usdm_agg_trades.description: Returns compressed aggregate trades, where trades at the same price and taking side within 100ms are aggregated.

params.name: from_id
params.description: ID to get aggregate trades from INCLUSIVE.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Timestamp in ms to get aggregate trades from INCLUSIVE.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Timestamp in ms to get aggregate trades until INCLUSIVE.

response_fields.name: [].nq
response_fields.description: Normal quantity without the trades involving RPI orders

notes: Only trade histories within the past 48 hours (counted from now) can be queried.
If both startTime and endTime are sent, time between startTime and endTime must be less than 1 hour.
If fromId, startTime, and endTime are not sent, the most recent aggregate trades will be returned.
Only market trades will be aggregated and returned; insurance fund trades and ADL trades are not aggregated.
Sending both startTime/endTime and fromId might cause response timeout; send either fromId or startTime/endTime.

list_usdm_basis.description: Returns the futures basis for a pair.

response_fields.name: [].timestamp
response_fields.description: Start time of the period, in milliseconds.

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
Only the data of the latest 30 days is available.

list_usdm_continuous_klines.description: Returns kline/candlestick bars for a specific contract type.

params.name: pair
params.description: After CM migration, accepts both UM and CM pair values.

response_fields.description: Array of kline arrays; positional meaning in response_notes

list_usdm_continuous_klines.response_notes: Each item is a 12-element array in order: open time (int), open, high, low, close, volume, close time (int), quote asset volume, number of trades (int), taker buy base asset volume, taker buy quote asset volume, ignore (all strings unless noted).
notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent klines are returned.
Klines are uniquely identified by their open time.

list_usdm_funding_rate_history.weight: Shares the 500/5min/IP rate limit with GET /fapi/v1/fundingInfo

params.name: start_time
params.description: Timestamp in ms to get funding rate from INCLUSIVE.

params.name: end_time
params.description: Timestamp in ms to get funding rate until INCLUSIVE.

response_fields.name: [].markPrice
response_fields.description: mark price associated with a particular funding fee charge

response_fields.name: [].rateType
response_fields.description: Funding rate type. `Regular` for the normal funding rate; `Special` for the additional funding rate generated by stock dividends.

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent 200 records are returned.
If the number of data between startTime and endTime is larger than limit, return as startTime + limit.
In ascending order.

list_usdm_historical_trades.description: Returns older market historical trades; requires an API key but no signature.

params.name: from_id
params.description: TradeId to fetch from. Default gets most recent trades.

notes: Market trades means trades filled in the order book; insurance fund trades and ADL trades are not returned.
Only supports data from within the last one month.

list_usdm_index_price_klines.description: Returns kline/candlestick bars for the index price of a pair.

params.name: pair
params.description: After CM migration, accepts both UM and CM pair values.

response_fields.description: Array of kline arrays; positional meaning in response_notes

list_usdm_index_price_klines.response_notes: Each item is a 12-element array in order: open time (int), open, high, low, close, ignore, close time (int), ignore, ignore (int), ignore, ignore, ignore (strings unless noted).
notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent klines are returned.
Klines are uniquely identified by their open time.

list_usdm_klines.description: Returns kline/candlestick bars for a symbol.

params.name: symbol
params.description: After CM migration, accepts both UM and CM symbols.

response_fields.description: Array of kline arrays; positional meaning in response_notes

list_usdm_klines.response_notes: Each item is a 12-element array in order: open time (int), open, high, low, close, volume, close time (int), quote asset volume, number of trades (int), taker buy base asset volume, taker buy quote asset volume, ignore (all strings unless noted).
notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent klines are returned.
Klines are uniquely identified by their open time.

list_usdm_mark_price_klines.description: Returns kline/candlestick bars for the mark price of a symbol.

params.name: symbol
params.description: After CM migration, accepts both UM and CM symbols.

response_fields.description: Array of kline arrays; positional meaning in response_notes

list_usdm_mark_price_klines.response_notes: Each item is a 12-element array in order: open time (int), open, high, low, close, ignore, close time (int), ignore, ignore (int), ignore, ignore, ignore (strings unless noted).
notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent klines are returned.
Klines are uniquely identified by their open time.

response_fields.name: [].timestamp
response_fields.description: End time of the period, in milliseconds.

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
Only the data of the latest 1 month is available.
IP rate limit 1000 requests/5min.
A period with no trades has no record and is omitted from the response; such gaps are not backfilled.

list_usdm_premium_index_klines.description: Returns premium index kline bars for a symbol.

params.name: symbol
params.description: After CM migration, accepts both UM and CM symbols.

response_fields.description: Array of kline arrays; positional meaning in response_notes

list_usdm_premium_index_klines.response_notes: Each item is a 12-element array in order: open time (int), open, high, low, close, ignore, close time (int), ignore, ignore (int), ignore, ignore, ignore (strings unless noted).
notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent klines are returned.
Klines are uniquely identified by their open time.

list_usdm_recent_trades.description: Returns recent market trades for a symbol.
notes: Market trades means trades filled in the order book; insurance fund trades and ADL trades are not returned.

response_fields.name: [].timestamp
response_fields.description: Start time of the period, in milliseconds.

notes: If startTime and endTime are not sent, the most recent data is returned.
Only the data of the latest 30 days is available.
IP rate limit 1000 requests/5min.

ping_usdm.description: Tests connectivity to the USDⓈ-M Futures REST API.
